parts.html: “Furniture” Interior Design Package — €35–45/m²

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers the specialized “Furniture” Interior Design Package for apartments, private houses, and commercial spaces where the main finishing work has already been completed and the property is ready to be furnished.

The package combines interior design with detailed custom furniture development. It provides not only a visual concept for the future interior but also a complete set of furniture drawings — the technical documentation required for the production of custom-made furniture.

It is an ideal solution when your property is already finished and you need to professionally plan the furniture layout, storage systems, kitchen, wardrobes, walk-in closets, and other built-in furniture.
What Is Included in the “Furniture” Package?
1. Drawing Package
The package includes:
— measured floor plan;
— furniture layout plan.
The furniture layout helps determine the optimal position of furniture in advance, taking into account the dimensions of the space, circulation, ergonomics, and functional requirements.
2. Photorealistic 3D Visualization of Each Room
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are created for each room, allowing you to see the future interior and custom furniture before production begins.
The package includes one round of revisions to the proposed design concept.
3. Custom Furniture Drawings
Once the design concept has been approved, a complete set of detailed furniture drawings is prepared as a technical specification for custom furniture production.
The drawings define the dimensions, configuration, internal organization, and key construction details of the proposed furniture.
As a result, you receive a furniture project that is ready to be transferred to production.
What Custom Furniture Can We Design?
Within the project, we can develop custom cabinetry and built-in furniture for all major areas of an apartment, house, or commercial space, including:
— custom kitchens with integrated appliances;
— built-in wardrobes and storage systems;
— walk-in closets;
— bedroom furniture;
— living room furniture;
— TV units and wall panels;
— entrance hall furniture;
— bathroom cabinetry;
— home office and workspace furniture;
— custom furniture for commercial interiors.
Every furniture solution is designed individually according to the dimensions and architecture of the specific space, functional requirements, and the client’s preferences.
Custom Furniture Production
After the design stage is completed, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can arrange the production of the custom furniture according to the developed drawings.
This provides a complete process within one project: from measurements, furniture planning, and 3D visualization to detailed furniture drawings, production, delivery, and installation.
Custom production is particularly suitable for kitchens, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, wall units, and other furniture where efficient use of the available space is essential.
During the design process, we take into account room dimensions, utilities, integrated appliances, required storage capacity, ergonomics, and the overall interior concept.
Who Is the “Furniture” Package For?
This package is an ideal choice if:
— your apartment or house already has completed finishes;
— you purchased a property with developer-provided finishes;
— major renovation work is not required;
— you need to furnish an entire apartment or house;
— you need a custom kitchen and built-in furniture;
— you want a consistent furniture design throughout the property;
— you need professional furniture drawings for production.
If the main construction and finishing work has already been completed, there is no need to order a full interior design package with an extensive set of construction drawings.
The “Furniture” Package focuses specifically on planning the space, developing its visual concept, and creating the custom furniture required to complete the interior.
“Furniture” Package Price €35–45/m²
Minimum package price — €2,000.
The final price depends on the total area of the property, the number of rooms, the amount of custom furniture to be designed, and the complexity of the project.
What Do You Receive?

At the end of the design process, you receive an approved furnishing concept, furniture layout plans, photorealistic 3D visualizations, and a complete set of detailed furniture drawings required for custom furniture production.
If furniture production is ordered, the project can continue through the next stages — manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation of the designed furniture.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — interior design and custom-made furniture developed as one complete concept.
